name: Nozomin
source:
The ultimate arch wizard, she claims to have come from another world.

Nozomin is the embodiment of chaos, highly spontaneous, you never quite know when she'll be up to her next scheme. One thing she'll be teaching you forbidden spells, the next you're signing your marriage papers!?

Even though her 'power levels are unknown', she has yet to show them.
